verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation that Postman stores collections as plain-text files in a repository or integrates with git. Workspace "versioning" is an in-app collaboration feature. The Postman API is a developer building block, not this capability. The community mention of exporting and importing JSON files describes a user-side workaround, not native repo-based storage.

support.subject: As a developer, I can store collections as plain text files in my repo and version them with git
